label: IMMENSE_2 is present to all whenever they are, from sustaining causation and contact (inference)
rule: Creator conjunct of IMMENSE_2 at each present thing, through presence-in-act; sustaining reading; then the derived sustainer-presence step
meaning: New non-transcription conditional derivation of the presence step that the immensity sense bridge 8bf775e9 carried untyped. Let g be IMMENSE_2 and x, other than g, present at t in history v. x is in act as to being (presence-in-act), so g causes x's being (creator conjunct); by the sustaining reading g gives x being at every moment x is present, so g sustains every other thing present at some moment; by the contact principle (through sustainerOfAllIsPresentToAll) g is present at t and gives x being then. The infinity conjunct is not used. Each premise is needed in a checked interpretation: with the originating reading in place of the sustaining one (existential inertia, Control part 1), without the contact principle (part 2), without the sustaining reading (part 3), without presence-in-act (part 4); all premises and the conclusion hold together nonvacuously (part 7). All three premises stay OPEN; the sustaining reading is where the existential-inertia dispute sits. No premise is established.
